fact: On 3 October 2026 the Ministry of National Education and New Citizenship published online the Annuaire statistique de l'enseignement préscolaire, primaire et secondaire for school year 2023-2024 (validated 5 June 2026), drawing on one administrative source, the school returns (schools, classes, pupils, teachers, staff, infrastructure) compiled through DIGE with the INS and provincial services; the text names no other source and no earlier edition.
title: RDC : l’annuaire statistique scolaire 2023-2024 désormais accessible au public
